## About

Sophia Stein builds local-first LLM infrastructure and provides consulting on agentic systems,
workflow automation, and eliminating cloud AI dependency. Achieved 28.4 t/s on AMD Strix Point
via ROCm 7.3 with a 90GB GART pool.
